identity_checks.detail: Both print the string "08/05/1969", but in their own formats this is 1969-08-05 (Pentacam MDY) vs 1969-05-08 (EyeSuite DMY): a day/month inversion, non-blocking per 0.B; must appear on the laudo Identidade line. A naive string compare would wrongly call it an exact match.
